quickAdd.hint: Separate with commas or spaces. 1-20 is a range and 45x2 is two copies. F12 is card 12’s foil, and ranges work too (F1-F20).
quickAdd.empty: Main set cards are 1–204 (Epic, Enchanted and Iconic cards start at 205).

help.tiers: Standard, Master or Grand Master: pick what you’re collecting above the cards. Standard is the 204 main set cards. Master adds the 204 foils. Grand Master adds the 18 Epic, 18 Enchanted and 2 Iconic cards. Cards you’ve marked are kept when you switch.

about.title: About the Hyperia City set
paragraphs: Hyperia City is the 14th Disney Lorcana booster set, released on 23 October 2026. It has 242 cards: 204 in the main set, 18 Epic, 18 Enchanted and 2 Iconic cards. There are also 204 foils, one for each main set card.

Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 204 main set cards), the Master set (408 cards, adding the foils) or the Grand Master set (all 446 cards, adding the Epic, Enchanted and Iconic cards).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
Card details come from LorcanaJSON, card images from Lorcast and prices from TCGplayer.
